entities.name: Basilica of Sant'Apollinare in Classe
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Basilica of Sant'Apollinare in Classe is a church in Classe, Ravenna, Italy, consecrated on 9 May 549 by the bishop Maximian and dedicated to Saint Apollinaris, the first bishop of Ravenna and Classe.
